stemMd: Complete hydrolysis of a pure protein would mainly yield which class of organic molecules?
explanationMd: Hydrolysis cleaves the peptide bonds linking amino-acid residues. The product class follows from the polymer's monomers; a protein is not a carbohydrate, lipid or nucleic acid.

distractorRationale.a: Protein backbones are not built from steroid units.
distractorRationale.e: These derive from hydrolysis of many lipids.
distractorRationale.b: These are the monomers of many carbohydrates.
